svg.aria-label: Comic: Copper as an assembly line. Robots work at stations along one conveyor in a single factory; each tray has a slot for scan, imu and cmd; trays are filled in the same order every cycle under a clock; every tray is recorded on tape and can be replayed exactly
svg.title: Copper as an assembly line, as a comic
svg.text: One program, one factory: no network inside.
Each tray has one slot per message.
Same order, every cycle, on the clock.
Every tray is recorded, and replays exactly.
